title: Best Chromebooks (2026)
summary: 3 top Chromebooks tested by PCWorld: best overall, best budget and best high-end.
method: Picks come from PCWorld's hands-on Chromebook testing (updated Oct 14, 2026). Specs and battery figures are for the configurations they tested; retail listings can differ in processor, RAM and storage, so check the exact configuration before buying. We don't show prices because they change daily. The three picks cover three different needs: the best all-rounder, the lowest-cost option and a premium step-up.
assumptions: only picks with fully documented test results are listed, so this is a top-3 guide rather than a top-5.

products.name: Asus Chromebook Plus CX34
pros: Fast, smooth performance with many tabs open
Plenty of ports, so no dongles needed
cons: The 16:9 screen feels a bit cramped
products.best_for: One Chromebook that handles schoolwork, streaming and video calls.

products.name: Asus Chromebook CX15
pros: Very low price for what you get
cons: Battery is short for a Chromebook
products.best_for: Web browsing and YouTube on a tight budget.

products.name: Lenovo Chromebook Plus 14
pros: Strong performance for a fanless Chromebook
cons: Small function keys are hard to read and pick up fingerprints
The AI features feel unnecessary in daily use
products.best_for: A Chromebook that looks and feels premium.
